ACTUAL.rationale: Exact paid membership is inherited from the locked October snapshot.

changes.subject: higgsfield-current
changes.condition: Only after Higgsfield vs Google Flow benchmark proves >=~80% recurring accepted-workload coverage and remaining unique Higgsfield value is not material.

LEAN.rationale: No immediate paid-plan removal is evidence-backed; Higgsfield is the first conditional redundancy candidate.

changes.subject: runway-paid-video
changes.condition: Only if Higgsfield and included Google Flow fail the accepted video workload, Runway proves unique required value, and the Economic Gate passes.

changes.subject: firecrawl-paid
changes.condition: Only after real quota/feature limitation materially blocks recurring research and reroute/free alternatives are insufficient.

changes.subject: elevenlabs-paid
changes.condition: Only after representative voice quality is verified and free-first capacity/quality becomes insufficient for actual production volume.

changes.subject: buffer-paid
changes.condition: Only after publishing/metrics workflow is verified and manual/native workflow creates recurring burden that free/current Buffer cannot solve.

changes.subject: chatgpt-higher-tier
changes.condition: Repeated early depletion or blocked commercial workload, reroute exhausted, and high-cost Economic Gate PASS.

changes.subject: cursor-higher-tier
changes.condition: Repeated early engineering-capacity depletion materially blocks repository work, alternatives do not preserve productivity, and applicable Economic Gate passes.

SCALE.rationale: No paid expansion is justified today; all expansion candidates remain conditional.
